name: textarea
title: Textarea
description: Multi-line text input for notes, requests and longer answers.

props.name: optional
props.description: Adds a muted "(Optional)" after the label: the `optional` label.

props.name: error
props.description: An error message (replaces the hint), or `true` to mark the field invalid without one.

props.name: wrapperClassName
props.description: Classes for the outer wrapper (label + field + hint row). `className` styles the field.

props.name: data-force
props.description: Show a state without interacting, for state sheets.
